scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @coffee-shop/protocol build && concurrently -n hub,web -c yellow,cyan "pnpm --filter @coffee-shop/hub dev" "pnpm --filter @coffee-shop/web dev"
scripts.dev:full: pnpm --filter @coffee-shop/protocol build && concurrently -n hub,web,worker -c yellow,cyan,magenta "pnpm --filter @coffee-shop/hub dev" "pnpm --filter @coffee-shop/web dev" "pnpm --filter @coffee-shop/worker dev"
scripts.worker: pnpm --filter @coffee-shop/protocol build && pnpm --filter @coffee-shop/worker build && pnpm --filter @coffee-shop/worker start
